summary: Computes an intersection ratio t for a line segment (a1 to a3) against a plane parameterized by a2 (x component, read from this+0x0) and a4 (z component, read from this+0x8). Tests the plane x/z components against the zero threshold flt_59E440 and splits into two algebraically equivalent branches depending on which component is nonzero. Returns FLT_MAX (flt_59EAE0) when both plane components are zero or when the computed denominator is zero; otherwise returns v9 / v10. Called by VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate (004441F0).

operations.description: Computes deltas v4 = a3.x - a1.x and v15 = a3.z - a1.z; plane parameters are read from a2 (x, this+0x0) and a4 (z, this+0x8)
Degenerate-plane guard: when a4.x is zero (against the flt_59E440 threshold) the a4.z branch runs; if both a4.x and a4.z are zero the function returns FLT_MAX (flt_59EAE0)
Branch with nonzero a4.x: v14 = a4.z / a4.x, numerator v9 = v15 - v4 * v14, denominator v10 = a2.z - v14 * a2.x
Branch with a4.x zero (a4.z nonzero): v13 = v6 / v7, numerator v9 = v4 - v13 * v15, denominator v10 = a2.x - v13 * a2.z
Denominator guard: when v10 equals zero (parallel / no intersection) the function returns FLT_MAX (flt_59EAE0)
Returns the ratio v9 / v10, or FLT_MAX on the degenerate cases; called by VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate (004441F0)
